rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a completed action that happened before a past reference point.

example.english: When I got home, Mum had already eaten.
example.traditional: 我返到屋企嗰陣，阿媽已經食咗飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6 aa3 maa1 ji5 ging1 sik6 zo2 faan6

rows.note: Use this when the earlier action is presented as something that had already happened or been experienced before then.

example.english: Before I moved to Hong Kong, I had been to Japan.
example.traditional: 我搬嚟香港之前去過日本。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bun1 lei4 hoeng1 gong2 zi1 cin4 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2
